name: zutil_zrdr_init_wildcard_path
description: zUtil_ZRDR::InitWildcardPath initializes in-place wildcard expansion state for up to five '*' characters and returns the first expanded path.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; defer to a coherent zReader/ZRDR source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a5f90 validates null-pattern return, resetting five wildcard pointer/digit slots, storing the pattern, scanning backward for up to five '*' bytes, returning null when no wildcard exists, rewriting wildcard bytes with digit zero through sprintf("%d"), and returning the mutated pattern.
The native smoke verifies null and no-wildcard behavior, first expansion, digit storage, two-wildcard ordering, and the five-wildcard limit.
